description: This file declares the `BroadcastToSPMDExpander` class, which is a specialized class used within TensorFlow's DTensor MLIR expansion framework to handle broadcast-to operations with SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) expansion logic. It defines method signatures for expanding the operation and computing input/output layouts.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation*, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>&)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation*, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>&)

classes.name: BroadcastToSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that extends SPMDExpanderBase to provide functionality for broadcasting tensors with SPMD expansion in TensorFlow DTensor.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Generates an expanded MLIR operation for broadcasting a tensor according to SPMD rules.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the input layout given the operation and output layouts for forward propagation.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the output layout given the operation and input layouts for backward propagation.
